title: docs(testability): ADR-0054 UI testability contract + audit
body:
## Why

The top-bar **"Search… ⌘K" button doesn't open the palette under automation**. Investigating it showed this is **a family of problems, not one button**: any UI that relies on a human-convenience shortcut (synthetic re-dispatched events, `toggle`-as-open, hover/keyboard-only entry, `useState`-only overlay state, hand-added locators, ad-hoc waits) is non-deterministic for **AI browser testing** — the direction the platform is heading.

## What

Docs only — the governance layer first, implementation phased after.

- **`docs/audits/2026-06-ui-testability.md`** — grep-grounded audit of 7 anti-pattern classes with `file:line`. Baseline counts on `main`: **2** synthetic-keyboard triggers (the palette button), **5** toggle-as-open paths, **56** `meta/ctrlKey` handlers, **16** `onMouseEnter` entries, **726** `data-testid` vs **1222** `onClick` (~40% gap), **0** global settle signals.
- **`docs/adr/0054-ui-testability-contract.md`** — a 7-invariant **UI testability contract** (idempotent/direct triggers, no sole keyboard/hover gate, URL-addressable state, renderer-emitted locators, machine-readable async state, trusted-input honesty, isolatable runs) + a phased rollout + a CI ratchet in the spirit of the spec liveness ledger.

## Key insight

The platform **generates** UIs, so testability is a property of the **renderer/design-system**, not of per-app hand-written tests. Fix the shared overlay/field primitives once → every generated app inherits a testable surface. Since the author and tester are both increasingly AI, this contract is a prerequisite, not polish.

## Phasing (follow-up PRs, each browser-verified)

1. Reference fix: command palette → idempotent `openCommandPalette()` + `data-testid`, drop synthetic `⌘K` dispatch; `useRecordSearch` unit test.
2. Overlay primitives default to idempotent `open()` + locators + `data-state`.
3. Global in-flight/idle signal in app-shell's data layer.
4. Metadata-derived `data-testid` across `fields` + `components/ui`.
5. ESLint + `check`/conformance ratchet (no new untestable surface).

## Test plan

Docs only — no code paths changed.
